source: live run 161935925891676 (agent 5.1.4, vs514 retail) model.json, trimmed to the campaign products and their referencers

domains.name: order
domains.description: Single source of truth for the omnichannel order lifecycle across channels — POS in-store, e-commerce, BOPIS, ROPIS, BORIS, and SFS. Owns order capture, order header/line, shipment, delivery, OMS fulfillment orchestration (DOM), fulfillment routing, SLA
domains.references: Manhattan Active Omni / IBM Sterling OMS

products.name: order_promotion
products.description: Association record linking a promotion or coupon applied to a sales order or order line. Captures promotion code, promotion type (BOGO, markdown, LTO, percentage-off, free-shipping), discount amount applied, promotion source (loyalty, campaign, POS

attributes.name: order_promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the order-promotion association record in the OMS. Primary key for this junction/transaction entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that generated or distributed this promotion. Enables campaign ROI measurement and attribution of discount spend to specific marketing initiatives.

attributes.name: product_promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master promotion definition record in the Pricing and Promotions system that governs the rules, eligibility, and discount logic for this promotion.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Pricing / Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: application_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotion discount was applied at the order header level, a specific order line level, or the shipment level. Determines how discount_amount is allocated.

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the promotion was applied to the order or order line. Represents the business event time of promotion redemption. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion application required manager or supervisor approval before being applied (True), such as for high-value manual overrides at POS.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all customer identity, profile, accounts, household relationships, segmentation, and loyalty data. Owns CRM records, RFM scoring, CLTV, CAC, NPS, loyalty program membership, purchase history, preferences, and consent/privacy

products.name: segment_membership
products.description: Association entity recording which customer profiles belong to which segments at any point in time. Tracks profile reference, segment reference, membership start date, membership end date, membership status (active, expired), assignment method

attributes.name: segment_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each segment membership record in the Databricks Silver layer. Primary key for the segment_membership entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign that triggered or is associated with this segment membership assignment. Populated when assignment_method is campaign.

attributes.name: assigned_by
attributes.description: Username or system process identifier that created or last modified this segment membership assignment. Supports audit trail for manual and automated assignments.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the customer was assigned to this segment. Rule-based = automated criteria engine; manual = analyst override; ml_model = predictive model output; import = batch ETL load.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of sale/sharing of personal data for this segment's use. True = opted out; segment use restricted.

tag_set.value: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records every tracked customer touchpoint and engagement event across all channels at Vs514 Retail, sourced from Salesforce Service Cloud cases and Marketing Cloud engagement data.
products.reference: Salesforce Service Cloud — Activity / Engagement Event

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer touchpoint or engagement event record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the interaction data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign in Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze that triggered or is associated with this outbound interaction event.

attributes.name: journey_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the automated customer journey in Salesforce Marketing Cloud that this interaction belongs to, enabling journey-level engagement analytics.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the web or app session during which this interaction occurred, enabling session-level journey stitching and conversion rate analysis.

attributes.name: bounce_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of email bounce if the message was not delivered: hard bounce (permanent delivery failure) or soft bounce (temporary failure). Null if delivered.

attributes.name: browser_type
attributes.description: Web browser used by the customer during a web-based interaction (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox), used for digital experience optimization and accessibility compliance.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the marketing campaign associated with this interaction, used for reporting and attribution analysis.

products.name: nps_response
products.description: Stores individual Net Promoter Score survey responses collected from customers at Vs514 Retail across post-purchase, post-service, and periodic relationship surveys.
products.reference: Net Promoter Score — Bain & Company / Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: nps_response_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual NPS survey response record in the Vs514 Retail customer domain silver layer.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing or CRM campaign that distributed this NPS survey, sourced from Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the survey template or campaign from which this response was collected, sourced from Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of sale/sharing of personal data, affecting permissible use of this response.

tag_set.value: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the customer's location at the time of survey response, used for geographic NPS segmentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this NPS response record was first created in the silver layer data product.

products.name: value
products.description: Point-in-time computed customer value record per profile capturing CLTV (customer lifetime value), predicted CLTV, CAC (customer acquisition cost) attributed at acquisition, total historical spend, average order value, margin contribution, value tier, and

attributes.name: value_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer value record. One record per customer per snapshot period representing the point-in-time computed value profile.

attributes.name: acquisition_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign in Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze that drove the customer acquisition event. Links CAC to specific campaign spend.

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: Marketing or sales channel through which the customer was originally acquired. Used to compute channel-level Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency and Return on Investment (ROI).

attributes.name: aov
attributes.description: Average Order Value (AOV) computed as total net revenue divided by total order count for this customer. Key metric for basket-building and upsell strategy.

attributes.name: cac_amount
attributes.description: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) attributed to this customer at the time of acquisition. Includes marketing spend, promotional discounts, and channel costs allocated at acquisition.

products.name: session
products.description: Master reference table for session. Referenced by session_id.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Primary key for session

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that drove this session. Used to attribute sessions and conversions to specific marketing initiatives.

attributes.name: app_version
attributes.description: Version of the Vs514 Retail mobile or web application used during the session. Used for release impact analysis and bug tracking.

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: Web browser name and version used during the session (e.g., Chrome 120, Safari 17). Applicable to web and mobile-web sessions.

attributes.name: cart_add_count
attributes.description: Number of times a product was added to the shopping cart during the session. Used for cart abandonment analysis and conversion funnel reporting.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master reference table for campaign. Referenced by acquisition_campaign_id.

attributes.name: actual_spend
attributes.description: Total amount actually spent on this campaign to date in the operating currency (USD). Used for budget variance and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the campaign was formally approved by the marketing governance or finance team for execution.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to this campaign in the operating currency (USD). Represents planned spend before execution.

products.name: journey
products.description: Master reference table for journey. Referenced by journey_id.

attributes.name: journey_id
attributes.description: Primary key for journey

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that owns or initiated this journey. Links journey performance back to campaign-level reporting.

attributes.name: ab_test_group
attributes.description: Experimental group assignment for the customer within this journey, enabling controlled A/B or multivariate test analysis of journey performance.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which this journey is delivered to the customer (e.g., email, in-store, mobile app). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push|in_store|web|mobile_app|direct_mail|social — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Customer's current marketing consent status at the time of journey enrollment. Ensures journey execution complies with privacy and consent regulations.

products.name: earning_rule
products.description: Master reference table for earning_rule. Referenced by earning_rule_id.

attributes.name: earning_rule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for earning_rule

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign that triggered or is associated with this earning rule, if the rule is campaign-driven.

attributes.name: accrual_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of days after a qualifying transaction before earned points are posted to the customer account (e.g., to allow for return window).

attributes.name: applicable_channel
attributes.description: The sales or interaction channel(s) through which this earning rule is valid. Supports omnichannel retail operations across store and e-commerce.

attributes.name: applicable_tier
attributes.description: The loyalty program tier(s) eligible for this earning rule (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum). Null or 'all' indicates the rule applies to all tiers.

products.name: survey
products.description: Master reference table for survey. Referenced by survey_id.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Primary key for survey

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that triggered or is associated with this survey distribution. Links survey results to campaign performance.

attributes.name: parent_survey_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original survey from which this version was derived. Supports version lineage tracking for recurring or revised surveys.

attributes.name: brand
attributes.description: The retail brand or banner under which this survey is conducted. Relevant for multi-brand retailers to segment survey results by brand.

attributes.name: business_domain
attributes.description: The primary business domain this survey is associated with, used for routing results to the appropriate data domain and stakeholder team.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the survey was closed and stopped accepting responses, whether by scheduled end_date, manual closure, or max_responses_target reached.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Single source of truth for all merchandise catalog data including SKU, UPC, EAN, GTIN, product attributes, hierarchy (department/class/subclass), assortment and planogram planning, pricing (MSRP, MAP, AUR, AUC, ASP), promotions (BOGO, LTO, markdown)
domains.references: GS1 GTIN / Akeneo PIM / Salsify / Oracle Retail Merchandising

products.name: product_promotion
products.description: Master record for all promotional pricing events managed by Vs514 Retail including markdowns, BOGO (Buy One Get One), LTO (Limited Time Offer), percentage-off, fixed-price, and clearance events.
products.reference: Promotion / Markdown / LTO / BOGO — Oracle Retail Pricing

attributes.name: product_promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a promotional pricing event record in the Vs514 Retail merchandise catalog. Primary key for the product_promotion data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that sponsors or drives this promotional event. Links promotion execution to campaign performance measurement in the Marketing and Loyalty domain.

attributes.name: applies_to_scope
attributes.description: Merchandise hierarchy level at which the promotion is defined and applied. Values: sku, style, subclass, class, department. Determines breadth of SKU eligibility within the hierarchy.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the merchandising or pricing manager who approved this promotional event. Required for SOX-compliant pricing change authorization workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Oracle Retail Pricing Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the promotional event received final business approval and was authorized for scheduling. Part of the SOX-compliant pricing change audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Oracle Retail Pricing Approval Workflow

products.name: digital_asset
products.description: Digital Asset Management (DAM) reference record for all media assets associated with a style or SKU. Stores asset_id, asset type (hero image, swatch, lifestyle photo, video, 360-spin, size guide, care label), asset URL or DAM system reference, file
products.reference: Digital Asset / DAM — Akeneo / Salsify / Bynder

attributes.name: digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each digital asset record in the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Primary key for the digital_asset product in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign for which this asset was created or is associated. Links DAM assets to campaign execution records in Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze.

attributes.name: alt_text
attributes.description: Descriptive alternative text for image assets used by screen readers and search engine optimization (SEO). Required for ADA/WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance on digital storefronts.

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the digital asset as defined in the DAM system. Used for search, discovery, and display in internal merchandising and e-commerce workflows.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the digital asset within the DAM workflow. Controls whether the asset is eligible for use on e-commerce storefronts, PIM enrichment, or marketing channels.

products.name: collection
products.description: Marketing/merchandising collection or curated category record for the digital storefront, distinct from the buyer-facing merchandise_hierarchy. Represents storefront navigation groupings such as 'Summer Essentials', 'New Arrivals', 'Back to School', or

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a marketing or merchandising collection record on the digital storefront (e.g., Summer Essentials, New Arrivals, Back to School).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Shopify Plus — Catalog Module

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: External identifier of the marketing campaign (from Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze) that launched or is associated with this collection, enabling campaign ROI attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Braze — Campaign Management

attributes.name: product_promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotion record associated with this collection when is_promotional is true. Links to the pricing and promotions domain for BOGO, LTO, or markdown events.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Pricing / SAP S/4HANA Retail — Promotions Module

attributes.name: age_group
attributes.description: Target age demographic for this collection, used for storefront navigation, CPSIA compliance filtering, and marketing audience segmentation.
attributes.references: CPSIA — Consumer Product Safety Improvement Act; Akeneo PIM

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee code of the manager or director who approved this collection for publication, supporting governance and change management workflows.
attributes.references: Akeneo PIM — Workflow Approval; Internal Governance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this collection was formally approved for publication by the designated approver, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master reference table for campaign. Referenced by campaign_id.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Primary key for campaign

attributes.name: applicable_price_type
attributes.description: The price type on which the campaign discount is calculated. Options include Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP), Minimum Advertised Price (MAP), Average Unit Retail (AUR), or Average Selling Price (ASP).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the merchandising or marketing manager who approved this campaign for execution. Supports governance and audit requirements.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the campaign received final approval from the authorized merchandising or marketing stakeholder.
